headline: TAZARA revival promises stronger Tanzania-China ties and a new trade lifeline across Africa
summary: The planned revitalisation of the Tanzania-Zambia Railway Authority is expected to raise freight capacity twelvefold and shorten transport times. The project is a partnership between Tanzania, Zambia and China.
why: TAZARA links landlocked Zambia to Tanzania's port of Dar es Salaam, so its capacity affects regional copper and cargo logistics costs.
